text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Wednesday it reiterated its rating of market performer for the intermediate six months and outperform for the 18 months on Photronics Inc after the company reported 1997 Q1 earnings in line with expectations.

--"There has been improvement in demand for photomasks in February, however we believe that results in the coming quarter will continue to be negatively impacted by lower capacity utilization due to the recent capital expenditures," noted analyst Robert Helf in a report.
--Helf's EPS estimate on the manufacturer of photomasks is unchanged at $1.94 for 1997. His new estimate for 1998 is $2.30, up $0.04 from $2.26.
